causeChain.fact: CompatibilityPDF builds Print PageLayerTree then layeredSVG, then native svgs_to_pdf_with_links; directPDF consumes PageLayerTree separately.
Linux defaultserif is Noto Serif CJK KR.
create_fontdb loads system+font_paths and sets genericserif to options fallback without selecting an existing family when absent.
Missing configured family produces warning but conversion continues.
Only percharacter select_fallback is customized; initial select_font remains usvgdefault.
Default initial selector queries listedfamilies and genericserif; missingmatches returnNone.
Query matches actual exact family names; genericserif resolves only to configured family string, then returnsNone if no candidate.
Initial font load creates spanfont cache; when absent, spans/chunks are skipped before percharacter fallback can rescue them.

Batang-family serif chain omits available Noto Sans KR. Explicit oldHangul familyname inchain is Source Han Serif K Old Hangul; actual bundled subsetnameID1 is Source Han Serif K, so it does not match that declared name.
